style: Modern 2010s TV cartoon-shorts animation style: bold, confident brush-weight black ink outlines with lively thick-thin line variation, flat cel colors with at most one flat shadow tone, squash-and-stretch construction, rubbery noodle limbs, big expressive eyes, very dynamic exaggerated pose, simple shapes, highly readable silhouette. Original character design, not based on any existing cartoon character. Clean flat cream paper background (#F5F0E6). Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers written anywhere, no watermark, no signature, no border.

cast.name: Fenn the Fox
cast.desc: a skinny, springy young orange fox with a cream muzzle, cream chest and cream tail tip, black socks on paws, tall pointy ears, wearing only a short teal scarf knotted at the neck

cast.name: Hoot the Owl
cast.desc: a round, egg-shaped little brown owl with a tan belly with a few V feather marks, small ear tufts, huge round eyes inside big round black-rimmed spectacles, short yellow beak and yellow feet, wearing a mustard-yellow knit beanie

cast.name: Tango the Turtle
cast.desc: a small chubby green turtle standing upright on two legs, with a dome shell in warm amber-orange with a darker hexagon pattern, cream belly plate, a big friendly grin, wearing red sneakers with white soles

cast.name: Pip the Rabbit
cast.desc: a lanky, long-eared soft lavender-grey rabbit with a white tummy, white muzzle, pink inner ears, big buck teeth, wearing sunflower-yellow overalls

cast.name: Bo the Bear
cast.desc: a big, round, chunky chocolate-brown bear with a tan muzzle and round tan belly patch, small round ears, wearing a red baseball cap turned backwards

cast.name: Ribbit the Frog
cast.desc: a bouncy bright lime-green frog with a pale yellow-green belly, huge bulging eyes on top of the head, wide mouth, long skinny legs with big feet, wearing a purple-and-white horizontally striped t-shirt

cast.name: Rizzo the Raccoon
cast.desc: a mischievous grey raccoon with a black bandit eye mask, white face markings, a big bushy black-and-grey ringed tail, wearing an orange hoodie

cast.name: Ollie the Otter
cast.desc: a sleek, stretchy brown otter with a cream face and cream belly, small round ears, long thick tail, whiskers, wearing blue swim goggles pushed up on the forehead

cast.name: Ellie the Elephant
cast.desc: a chubby baby elephant in soft blue-grey with big floppy ears with pink insides, a long expressive trunk, no tusks, wearing a bright pink t-shirt

cast.name: Percy the Penguin
cast.desc: a short plump penguin, black back and head, white belly and white face patch, orange beak and orange feet, wearing a red knit beanie with a white pom-pom and a matching red mitten on each flipper
